title: Random Team Generator
h1: Random Team Generator — Split Names into Fair Teams
seoTitle: Random Team Generator — Free Online Tool
description: Split a list of names into random teams of equal size. Perfect for classrooms, sports, meetings or games. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Paste names (one per line), choose how many teams, and get a fair random split instantly.
blurb: Randomly divide a list of people into balanced teams.
howItWorks: Enter each person's name on its own line.
Set the number of teams you want (minimum 2).
Click Generate Teams. Names are shuffled and distributed as evenly as possible.
examples: Classroom of 24 students into 6 groups of 4.
Office lunch teams of 5 from a list of 18 people.
Sports draft: randomly assign players to red and blue.

faq.q: Are the teams always equal size?
faq.a: As equal as possible. Leftover people are distributed one per team so no team is more than one larger than another.
Yes. It uses a Fisher-Yates shuffle powered by the browser's crypto.getRandomValues.
No. Everything happens locally in your browser.
